# FindMyBus

> Free live bus tracking for trackingo.in services — real-time location, stops, and delays. No account needed.

FindMyBus (findmybus.abhijithpsubash.com) is a free, privacy-first web application for tracking buses live in India. Users enter a trackingo.in tracking URL or bus code to see real-time bus location on an interactive map, stop-by-stop progress, estimated arrival times, and delay information. All data is stored locally in the browser — nothing is sent to FindMyBus servers.

## What FindMyBus does

- Shows the live bus location on a Leaflet/OpenStreetMap map
- Leads with the single most useful figure: which stop is next and how many minutes away
- Displays current bus speed and location name
- Lists every stop on the route with arrival times, delay status, and color-coded indicators
- Shows how far the bus has progressed along the route (percentage)
- Lets users pin their destination stop and see how many stops away the bus is
- Installs as a progressive web app and shows the last known position while offline
- Allows users to share a direct tracking link with others

## Relationship to Trackingo — important

FindMyBus does not track buses and holds no vehicle data. Bus operators track their vehicles using
Trackingo, a product of Bitla Software Pvt. Ltd. The operator gives the passenger a tracking code;
FindMyBus is an alternative front-end that renders that same trip more legibly, requesting one trip
at a time for a code the user supplied.

FindMyBus is an independent, unofficial project and is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or
connected to Bitla Software Pvt. Ltd. or Trackingo. Live bus data is provided by and belongs to
Bitla Software. Trademarks are used descriptively only, to state compatibility.

## Supported bus services

- **trackingo.in** — bus.trackingo.in (primary supported service)
  - Accepts full URLs: `https://bus.trackingo.in/customer/track_vehicle?AB1234`
  - Accepts short URLs: `https://trkg.in/OPERATOR/CD5678`
  - Accepts raw tracking codes: `AB1234`, `CD5678` (4–10 alphanumeric characters)
- More services: coming soon

## How to track a bus

1. Open https://findmybus.abhijithpsubash.com
2. Tap the "Add trip" button
3. Paste a trackingo.in URL or type the bus tracking code (e.g. AB1234)
4. Optionally give the trip a name (auto-generated from route if left blank)
5. View live tracking with map, stops, and timing

## Shareable tracking links

Each active tracking session has a shareable URL:

```
https://findmybus.abhijithpsubash.com/track/AB1234
```

Anyone who opens this link will immediately see live tracking for that bus, even without an account. The link works on any device.

## Privacy

- Saved trips, pinned stops and theme live only in the user's browser localStorage and are never
  transmitted anywhere
- No accounts, no cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts, no data sales
- Live tracking requests are proxied through the FindMyBus host (Netlify) to reach trackingo.in,
  because a browser cannot call it directly without hitting CORS. That proxy necessarily sees the
  request — IP address, user agent, and the tracking code in the URL — and standard access logs are
  retained by the host. FindMyBus does not read them, profile users, or retain anything itself, but
  it would be inaccurate to claim requests never reach a FindMyBus server.
- Map tiles are fetched by the browser directly from OpenStreetMap, which sees the IP for the same
  unavoidable reason.

## Technical

- Installable progressive web app (service worker, offline app shell, cached last-known position)
- Built with React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- Map: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles
- Live data: fetched from bus.trackingo.in API via a CORS proxy
- Deployment: Netlify (with server-side redirects for SPA routing)
- Source: https://github.com/abhijithpsubash (if public)

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: Which buses can I track?**
A: Any bus that has a tracking code or URL from trackingo.in (bus.trackingo.in). More services are being added.

**Q: Is this free?**
A: Yes, completely free. No account, no ads, no data sold.

**Q: Can I track a bus I didn't add myself?**
A: Yes — if someone shares a link like findmybus.abhijithpsubash.com/track/AB1234, you can open it and see live tracking immediately without any setup.

**Q: Does it work on mobile?**
A: Yes. FindMyBus is fully responsive. On phones it is a single-column app; on desktop it shows a
saved-trip sidebar alongside the live tracking view.

**Q: Can I install FindMyBus as an app?**
A: Yes. On Android and desktop Chrome you will see an Install button. On iPhone, use Share then Add
to Home Screen. Once installed it opens full screen and can still show the last known bus position
without a connection.
